text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Try to unwind as much as possible outside 
of training," you say?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, because you're always so serious 
that I get worried.

Yeah, because you're always so serious 
that I worry about you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting her to at least relax during her 
off-time at the training camp, I handed 
her a few tickets.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is this ticket for?
choice_data_list: It's a pool pass for the resort hotel.
It's a pool pass for the resort hotel!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A resort hotel pool... I see... So you're 
telling me to go let loose with my 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――Understood. Then I won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Too serious... I can understand why people 
might see me that way, but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then let's invite someone along. We'll 
find an Umamusume who hasn't been able to 
enjoy a carefree summer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, resting properly really is hard, 
isn't it? I always end up training without 
thinking...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"They told me again: 'You're way too bad 
at switching between on and off mode.'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that's how Top Road-chan feels. I tend 
to slack off and idle about too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to, you know, go all out and have 
fun like "whaaa!" a bit more, but I always 
end up just thinking, "Eh, whatever."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ――? Top Road-san and Mirako-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Um, to the both of you. If you'd like—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones Ikuno Dictus approached were 
Narita Top Road, the model-student class 
rep, and Hishi Miracle, an utterly 
ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Shall the three of us go out? To a 
fleeting... extraordinary moment.

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Miracle
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A facility like this, right near the 
training lodge...! How should I put it, 
um... it's awfully luxurious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a pool, everyone's just 
lying around, and no one is swimming...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't look like they'll force me to swim 
here, but it's so fancy it kinda makes me 
restless~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —What is the matter, you two?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, let's let loose and 
relax. There's no need to worry about 
prying eyes here.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy being our true selves.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, I-Ikuno-chan? Are you just casually 
fitting right in...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"It's kind of unexpected, or rather... I 
kinda figured none of us were the 
hype-and-energetic type, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you're actually... a wild 
and trendy Umamusume, Ikuno-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is not quite the case, however... As 
they say, "When in Rome, do as the Romans 
do."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I simply do what fits the occasion. Who I 
am right now is undeniably me as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened. I thought you 
were the kind of horse girl who never had 
fun at all~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true at all—and I'm sure the 
two of them feel the same way."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I just have a feeling. That you two also 
have a 'surprising side' that you don't 
usually show."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
An "unexpected side" that I normally don't 
show... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am certain that we share a very 
similar fated bond...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I think it would be fine for 
you to unleash your instincts even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see... Instinct, huh...? Well then, 
Mirako-chan, since we have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, true~. Let's take the plunge 
and...!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, acting like a celebrity is actually 
pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm...! Well then, let's all go wild 
and do whatever we want today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey~, excuse me, server? Could you 
bring us a cola? And the menu, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks to Ikuno-chan, I had a ton of 
fun today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's cola, pizza, and fries. And what 
else, what else~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I went to an ultra-luxurious spa and even 
got an ultra-luxurious massage. 
Heh-heh-heh~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
An ultra-luxurious massage and an 
ultra-luxurious spa?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the only thing I 
received from you was an admission ticket, 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Just an admission ticket? Which 
means...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, so the rest is out of pocket...?! I 
wonder if I have enough allowance?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Responding to Ikuno Dictus's SOS, I rushed 
to the scene. By paying for her on the 
spot, I managed to resolve the situation 
without issue.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, Trainer. After all your 
kindness, I went and caused you trouble...
choice_data_list: No, it's fine. As long as you had fun
No, it's fine. As long as you had fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard what kind of day it actually was 
from Ikuno Dictus later on. It seems I had 
misunderstood things quite a bit.
choice_data_list: You're not as stiff as I thought.
You're not as stiff as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm merely adapting to whatever 
the moment calls for.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps during this summer training camp, 
I should show more... of my true self.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Since we're here, how about we do 
some other summer recreation besides the 
pool?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Through that recreational activity, I hope 
you will come to know more about me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A summer recreational activity to get to 
know Ikuno Dictus better. What should we 
do?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A grand, extravagant nagashi somen setup, 
you say? Understood.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If we are doing this, I would like to 
enjoy it to the fullest as well. Now 
then—let us prepare."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... All the materials have 
been carried to the top of the cliff.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If we set up bamboo flumes from here and 
let it flow... that'd make for some pretty 
epic flowing somen noodles.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you really went for it all.
Yeah, you really went all out for it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because unless we give it everything, 
no one can truly enjoy it. Not everyone 
else, not Trainer, and not myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us assembled the giant 
nagashi somen flume...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Downstream Mirako-saaan! Releasing the 
water now~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Here you go, Ikuno-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, preparations for the test are 
complete. Flowing somen noodles, coming 
right up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oho, it's coming, it's coming, the somen 
is coming! Just a little bit more! Butâ!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Maybe that speed is a bit too fast!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wahhh, the somen noodles are escaping!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems there is a slight issue with 
the angle of incline. Let's reassemble it 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus enthusiastically got back to 
doing heavy labor. She truly enjoyed the 
giant flowing somen noodles.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A gaming tournament? That sounds nice. 
Having uninterrupted time like this is 
something you can only get at a training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Since we're all here, let's invite those 
two from earlier and play some cards 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of them decided to hold a 
card tournament. Ikuno Dictus wasn't bad 
at it, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You know, Ikuno-chan. You look like you'd 
be super good at games, but you're 
actually not, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, I am no expert in 
probability or numbers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see, if that's the case, then if I do my 
best, I might just be able to win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it looked like they were 
evenly matched. However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, Ikuno-chan won again~? And here I 
was winning at first...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The more time passes, the less chance I 
have to win. This is...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm no numbers expert, but— I have 
complete confidence in my enduring 
concentration."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And—an eye for judging people as well. 
Now, let us continue. We still have plenty 
of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Grit, endurance, and keen observation. 
Ikuno Dictus had put that power on full 
display.
